description: DRAFT (not registered). A4 default: tokens as patches on the A3 all-parts backbone (a3mx.json model block unchanged, d_model 384), trained jointly from scratch. Control A'': unshared 2-layer decoder with the r2_shared arm's unique decoder params (two different lswa+SwiGLU blocks, SwiGLU hidden 170 instead of 512); same passes, depth and init scale, fewer decoder FLOPs.

computed.note: computed by gogeta.c2f (FusionDance's counting rule: 2 x params per application + attention/GDN terms, training = 3 x forward); per token; NOT measured

notes: Global = a3mx.json's model block verbatim (prelude swa; core gdn,gdn,swa,gdn,gdn,swa x 2 loops, contractive inject; coda attn; ternary core with fp mixers and fp ends; MoE 4 experts top-2 core-only); its 8k BPE head is replaced by the byte decoder. Sizing: the r2_shared decoder (d_local 128, SwiGLU 512) costs about what the head it replaces costs, so arm a is ~1.00 x A3mx's own train FLOPs/token. Train block = a3mx's (code-py-v2, 1024 tokens, batch 32, 20M tokens, lr 0.006, warmup 300); --max-tokens counts TOKENS. val_loss is nats per token on code-py-v2 val, directly comparable with A3mx's val_loss. lr not tuned for the decoder.
